Claim 1 (Currently amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, __a compound of formula I:__

__[Chemical structure showing pyrazinopyrimidone ring system where R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl],__

[[a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof,]] or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]] __salt of BH4 or the compound of formula I__; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[AII]], __wherein the inhibitor is selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative]] __salt__ thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, __the compound of formula I,__ [[a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof,]] or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]] __salt of BH4 or the compound of formula I__, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[All]], __wherein the inhibitor is selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative]] __salt__ thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, __the compound of formula I,__ [[a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof,]] or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]] __salt of BH4 or the compound of formula I__, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[All]], __wherein the inhibitor is selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists,__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable [[derivative]] __salt__ thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

Claim 6 (Cancelled).

Claim 7 (Cancelled).

Claim 8 (Cancelled).

Claim 9 (Cancelled).

Claim 10 (Cancelled).

Claim 11 (Cancelled).

Claim 12 (Cancelled).

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 1 to 5, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[All]] is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[All]] is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII)__ [[All]] is a compound selected from the group consisting of eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan or, particularly, candesartan [[optionally in prodrug form, such as candesartan cilexetil]] __or candesartan cilexetil__.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5 __and 13 to 15__, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5 __and 13 to 15__, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5 __and 13 to 15__, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 5 __and 13 to 15__; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.
